text: A thin, bony look caused by poor nutrition is a visible sign of food deprivation that may also have shaped the person's traits.
quote: The person who has a thin, bony face owing to poor nutrition may also have psychological traits that derive from food deprivation.

text: A hostile temperament can show as a battered, worn appearance, because hostile people more often choose damaging activities such as boxing or heavy drinking.
quote: individuals with a hostile temperament may be more likely to choose activities that have a deleterious effect on their appearance, such as boxing or alcohol abuse

text: Very fair, pale skin makes others view and treat a person as sickly and fragile.
quote: the extremely fair-skinned person may evoke a certain kind of environment; she may be viewed and treated by others as if she were sickly and fragile

text: A very fair-skinned person who avoids the sun may stay less active, or may compensate and become visibly more robust than people who spend time outdoors.
quote: the fair-skinned person compensates for the deprivation of outdoor activities or for others' negative expectations by becoming even more robust

text: A naturally pale complexion resembles the pallor of fear, so the person is read as fearful and timid.
quote: because fear drains blood from the face, producing a pallor, someone with a naturally pale complexion may be perceived as fearful and timid

text: A naturally florid, ruddy complexion resembles an alcoholic's dilated capillaries, so the person is read as dissolute.
quote: Those with a naturally florid complexion may be perceived as dissolute, like an alcoholic with dilated capillaries, because of the resemblance in complexion.

text: Thick, dry skin can make a person be read as low in intelligence because it resembles a feature of cretinism.
quote: Someone with thick, dry skin or large or flabby ears may be perceived as low in intelligence like the cretin, whose features these resemble.

text: An erect posture, expansive relaxed body movements and a powerful-looking gait are read as signals of dominance and can offset a submissive-looking face.
condition: when a person (e.g. very babyfaced) wants to look less submissive
quote: using expansive and relaxed body movements, showing an erect posture, and exhibiting a powerful-looking gait

text: A powerful-looking gait is rapid and forward leaning, loose-jointed, with a large arm swing, long stride, considerable hip sway, bent knees, feet picked up and a bouncy rhythm.
quote: rapid, forward leaning, and loose-jointed with a large arm swing and stride length, considerable hip sway, knee bending, picking up of feet, and a relatively bouncy rhythm

text: Constrained, tight body movements, a stooped posture and a weak-looking gait are read as deference and soften the threatening look of a mature, dominant-looking person.
condition: when a person wants to look less threatening
quote: behaviors that signal deference: gaze aversion, raised eyebrows, constrained and tight body movements, a stooped posture, and a weak-looking gait
